user.title: Connect to Mistral AI
user.description: Enter your Mistral AI API key. Speech-to-text (Voxtral 3) and text-to-speech (Voxtral TTS 3) are set up automatically with the same key.

data_description.api_key: Create a key at console.mistral.ai with access to the Mistral Large and Voxtral models.
data_description.use_agent: Route conversations through a Mistral agent instead of a plain chat model.

data_description.model: Mistral chat model used for conversations and voice queries.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: Upper bound on how many Home Assistant tool calls a single request may trigger (1 to 10).
